abstract: Published online: 04 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41557-026-02291-7 While additives direct Zn electrocrystallization and impact battery performance, the mechanism remains disputed. Now it has been shown that facet-dependent work function modulation upon additive adsorption governs Fermi-level equilibration and Zn crystallographic texture across 29 additives with 93.1% accuracy, providing an interfacial electronic descriptor for additive screening towards favourable Zn electrodeposition.
